text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The Queen Elizabeth II Cup 
will soon be upon us, will it not?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list:
...Are you sure? You don't feel like 
entering?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I ran the Triple Tiara with every fiber of 
my being. 
Hence, we concluded together that taking 
a breath at this juncture would be best.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If so... let us simply savor 
our leisure for a time, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Together, we shall claim it in due time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Phalaenopsis temporarily stepped 
back 
from entering any races.
